verses.1: Let him be punished; let him not be spared from David’s punishment, after he fled from Shaul in the valley.
verses.2: God, save me! Save me, for in you I find refuge. My soul is safe in your wings, until these days are over.
verses.3: I will call out to the Lord, who is above all other gods.
verses.4: He will send down help from heaven and save me. God will show His kindness and truthfulness.
verses.5: My soul lies within their hearts. They sleep together, both of them being warriors and heroes. But in the end, they will be destroyed by destruction alone.
verses.6: Holy is God above the heavens; Holy is He over all the earth.
verses.7: The garments were prepared for me at times. My soul was filled with sorrow. Words fell from their mouths, and they became worthless.
verses.8: May God be pleased with me. May Ashira and Azamera also be pleased with me.
verses.9: It’s a shame, my honor… It’s a shame that it’s been destroyed. I will rise up and restore it to its former glory.
verses.10: O God of nations, I praise You in all nations.
verses.11: For your kindness reaches even to the heavens, and your truthfulness goes beyond all boundaries.
verses.12: Holy God, who reigns on high, may You honor Your name throughout the earth.
